name: summarize_agent_def
description: Generate (or refresh) a short, LLM-inferred plain-text summary of what an agent does, derived from its name, instructions, equipped tools, and triggers. The summary is cached against a checksum of the agent's current config: it is only regenerated when the config has changed since the last summary, or when `force` is set. Returns the summary and the checksum it was derived from.

agentId.description: Agent public id (agt_…), UUID, or slug — workspace-scoped.

summary.description: Plain-text (<=256 char) description of what the agent does and what it works with. No markdown, no quotes.

checksum.description: SHA-256 of the canonical version config this summary was derived from. Detects staleness on the next call.
